## Known limitations of this import

- docs/, evals/, tests/ and .claude/ are not vendored. Skills reference them in prose, including docs/api, docs/experiments, docs/cookbook, evals/CALIBRATION.md, evals/THIRD_PARTY.md and tests/session.test.ts, so those paths do not resolve here.
- skills/jev/scripts/jev.py is vendored as content. The pyproject.toml and the jev-decide console entry point are not, so the CLI is not installed as a command.
- skills/jev-eval/agents/openai.yaml is shipped content, not an agent registration this repository honours.
